memberTowns.asPublished: Kearsarge Regional School District (SAU #65) is composed of seven towns governed by one regional School Board consisting of nine members. The towns represented are Bradford, Newbury, New London, Springfield, Sutton, Warner, and Wilmot.
memberTowns.correctsAssumption: The h brief's own working list was 'New London, Sutton, Bradford, Springfield, Wilmot, Goshen' and instructed that it be verified rather than assumed. It is wrong in BOTH directions: Goshen is NOT a member town, and Warner IS — with three of the nine seats. Goshen's school district is a different one. A member list guessed from a map is a claim about which children go to which school.

falseAnswerRejected.why: Those three are where the district's school BUILDINGS sit, and every page on the site carries them in its navigation menu. Harvesting town names from the whole document returns 'where the schools are' — a different fact wearing the answer's clothes. A regional district by definition serves towns with no school building of their own, and Newbury, Springfield, Warner and Wilmot are exactly those. The first pass of this hunt returned the three-town answer and it was rejected rather than recorded.

officers.name: Debra Breault
officers.note: An officer of the district, not one of the nine board seats. Counted separately so the seat count stays 9, which is what the district itself states.

beyondMatrix.note: None of these are required by field matrix vH-1. All were on the page already, and the expensive part of any hunt is REACHING the page — a second visit for them would pay the whole discovery cost again. Candidates for a vH-2 schema correction.
